fix(core): resolve timer and listener leaks in table widget, live preview, and wikilinks

Fix 7 bugs across 4 files:

Bug 1 (live-preview-table): promote onDocMouseDown to class field so
destroy() can remove the document-level mousedown listener.

Bug 2-4 (widget-extension, live-preview, wikilinks): store
compositionend timeout per EditorView via view.plugin(viewCapture)
instead of shared closure — prevents cross-instance timer stomping.

Bug 5 (live-preview-table): add LRU eviction (limit 50) to
tableColumnWidths Map with touch-on-get for true LRU ordering.

Bug 6 (live-preview): add LRU eviction (limit 50) to MERMAID_CACHE
Map with touch-on-get for true LRU ordering.

Bug 7 (live-preview-table): store context menu setTimeout ID so
cleanup() can clearTimeout, preventing dangling document listener
when cleanup runs before timer fires.
